eeprom_map.0x20: cal_v_gain_ch1   float32 LE (multiply INA219 V reading)
eeprom_map.0x24: cal_v_offset_ch1 float32 LE (add to INA219 V reading, in V)
eeprom_map.0x28: cal_i_gain_ch1   float32 LE (multiply INA219 I reading)
eeprom_map.0x2C: cal_i_offset_ch1 float32 LE (add to INA219 I reading, in mA)
eeprom_map.0x60: cal_dac_gain     float32 LE (DAC full-scale correction factor)
eeprom_map.0x64: cal_temp_offset  float32 LE (NTC temperature offset in C, all channels)

calibration_procedure: Step 1: Ensure board_type EEPROM = 'FL1-ELOAD' via RUN SELFTEST
Step 2: Apply 5.000V to CH1 DUT input connector, enable 500mA CC load, wait 5s for thermal steady-state
Step 3: Read V_ina = read_telemetry().channels[0].v; measure V_actual with NIST-traceable DMM
Step 4: Compute cal_v_gain_ch1 = V_actual / V_ina; write float32 LE to EEPROM 0x20
Step 5: Apply 1.000A CC load, measure I_actual with NIST-traceable ammeter (>= 0.05% accuracy)
Step 6: Compute cal_i_gain_ch1 = I_actual / (I_ina / 1000.0); write float32 LE to EEPROM 0x28
Step 7: Repeat steps 2-6 for CH2 (0x30-0x3C), CH3 (0x40-0x4C), CH4 (0x50-0x5C)
Step 8: Set DAC to 1.000V on CH1 (SET LOAD1 <mA for 1V/100mOhm=10A - use lower>), measure V_dac on TP_DAC1 pad
Step 9: Compute cal_dac_gain = V_measured / 1.000; write to 0x60
Step 10: Place calibrated thermometer near CH1 MOSFET, read temp_c from telemetry, compute offset
Step 11: Write cal_temp_offset = T_actual - T_reported; write float32 LE to EEPROM 0x64
Step 13: Compute XOR checksum of bytes 0x00-0x1C, write to 0x1D
Step 14: Run RUN SELFTEST to verify EEPROM readback and board_type check
notes: All float32 values use IEEE 754 little-endian (LSB first), matching struct.pack('<f', val)
Default gain = 1.0, default offset = 0.0 (uncalibrated identity transform)
Firmware applies: V_cal = (V_raw + v_offset) * v_gain at telemetry read time
INA219 calib_reg = 4096 gives 10uA current LSB (see INA219 datasheet eq. 3)
Sense resistor tolerance of ±1% contributes ±1% I accuracy before calibration
Op-amp gain error (MCP6002 VOS typ 0.5mV) contributes <0.2% at full scale
